selection: All completed-cohort queries whose exact joint audit failed and whose strongest combined greedy outcome did not; complete post hoc subset, not held-out validation

proof.algorithm: conditional batched one-edge envelopes and exact disjoint rank allocation
proof.count_semantics: Action representations may produce identical removed unions; counts are not unique edited graphs or measured speedups. All selected 1+1 slices are cached even when the requested rectangle is smaller.

certificate.interpretation: Exact for the declared frozen ranker and the rectangular budget of at most one selected provenance-group withdrawal plus at most one residual BINDS record deletion. A group removes the union of all records carrying its imported annotation; a residual record must survive that withdrawal. All competing compounds change jointly. Group and record budgets are separate units, not equal amounts of evidence. Source labels are not independent suppliers, and a citation need not identify one experiment. This is an evidence-quarantine sensitivity analysis, not a factual retraction, clinical effect, error probability or new biological discovery. Exactness is relative to decimal80-binary64-v1. Unselected annotations, other relation families, larger budgets, new records and model refitting are outside scope.

checks: Certificate identity and content checksum match
All fields match independently reconstructed conditional envelopes
Every distinct witness matches independent full-matrix replay
verification.verification_method: Separate same-algorithm conditional-envelope recomputation and independent edited-matrix replay. Exhaustive tiny-graph maximality is tested separately.

greedy.method: Two-order global-rank greedy: source-first and edge-first; the first action is chosen without lookahead, then the other action is optimized. Unsupported beats supported; ties minimize focus-score minus kth supported-rival score, then focus-score, action count and IDs. No-action prefixes are included. A first edge swallowed by a group is deduplicated.
greedy.guarantee: Attainable witnesses only; no optimality or robustness guarantee
